rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something foolishly or stupidly.

example.english: I foolishly trusted a stranger and didn't even realize I'd been scammed.
example.traditional: 我傻傻地信咗個陌生人，畀人呃咗都唔知。
example.jyutping: ngo5 so4 so2 dei2 seon3 zo2 go3 mak6 saang1 jan4 bei2 jan4 ngaak1 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1

rows.jyutping: mou5 nam2 cing1 co2 zau6 V
rows.note: Use this when the foolishness specifically comes from acting without thinking a decision through.

example.english: I foolishly bought such an expensive phone without thinking it through, and only now realize it doesn't suit me.
example.traditional: 我冇諗清楚就買咗部咁貴嘅手機，而家先知唔啱用。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 nam2 cing1 co2 zau6 maai5 zo2 bou6 gam3 gwai3 ge3 sau2 gei1 ji4 gaa1 sin1 zi1 m4 ngaam1 jung6
